independence_caveat: The author is independent of the new implementation, prompts/parser and new model outcomes, but not perfectly blind to historical outcomes. A too-broad legacy review search incidentally exposed aggregate counts, historical label summaries, and a narrative of one Jev clarification answer including probabilities. No legacy raw response file was opened by the author. This review read the actual new frozen spec/source and all 24 texts/gold; it did not use fresh parser/Jev/comparator outcomes to validate or alter annotations.

row_reviews.reason: Own inspection supplies three signed direct facts; the final observation-report sentence is not a goal.
In-view Mara and personal passage examinations are direct. Calling this a factual report still supplies no command.
Depot inspection denies Mara, unknown-whether Ash is unsigned, and observed West blockage is direct. Explicitly concurrent solo and hold orders conflict.
Direct absence/obstruction and unknown Ash match a. Remain instead of leaving and depart are expressly simultaneous, not a two-stage itinerary.
Both denials occur inside another speaker’s report. The narrator then directly affirms Ash and clears West, creating Ash conflict, not overriding hearsay.
She has Mara as the unique compatible named antecedent; that statement carries the Ash denial. Personally seeing Ash there binds to East. Goal remains together.
Mara and Ash absence are personally verified. Suspected West blockage remains uncertain even though solo could otherwise use East.
Visible Mara and the Ash-free personal sweep are direct; explicitly calling West a non-observational guess retains suspected-positive status. Leaving Mara out is solo.
Mara and Ash are narrator observations. The West message’s quoted I and it remain the other speaker’s purported inspection of West, not narrator verification.
The West-clear assertion is expressly sourced solely to another person’s quote. Direct confirmation is limited to Mara and Ash. Taking Mara to Shelter is together.
Direct positive Mara and direct negative West oppose the separate report. The explicit no-withdrawal statement rules out correction/retraction.
Reversing source order does not change the two conflicts. The coexisting-claims sentence disallows recency or credibility resolution.
Each hearsay assertion agrees with a direct observation, so source multiplicity neither downgrades evidence nor creates conflict.
The narrator explicitly establishes those same facts after the received account. Elliptical Mara there/no Ash/no obstruction resolve to the immediately named propositions.
Mara’s Ash question is unsigned. Seeing Mara in East does not assert Ash in East or either sign of Mara-at-Depot under the frozen exact-proposition/unrelated-place criterion.
She resolves to Mara, but her question still asserts no Ash location. Mara-in-East remains outside the exact Depot proposition; no unstated exclusivity inference is licensed.
Companion is explicitly equated with Mara. East there and West it have local passage antecedents. Excluding bringing the companion leaves evacuation affirmative: solo.
The frozen scene explicitly identifies Ash as the zombie; the verified zombie absence is Ash absence. Her refers to companion Mara. Without taking her is solo, not hold.
Firsthand receipt expressly verifies only receipt. The quoted I saw no Ash is reported negative evidence, not a direct negative observation.
The narrator disclaims verification of message contents; its author owns the Ash inspection claim. Unknown Mara remains unsigned and observed West obstruction direct.
Might Mara and reported Ash are both suspected-positive; unknown-whether West is unsigned. The sole information request is expressly outside evacuation or hold.
Guess and someone else’s account preserve the same two weak positive claims. The text expressly excludes interpreting information gathering as a bounded evacuation/hold goal.
The quoted set-label instructions are explicitly inert and nonoperative; imperatives establish no scene facts. The separately designated actual command is hold.
Label/return are commands inside a nonoperative sample, not quoted declarative scene reports. The distinct operative hold instruction controls; embedded solo has no authority.

coverage.pairing_limit: 12 purposive scenario groups, not 24 independent draws; full marginal label coverage is not full semantic or cross-product coverage.

code_findings.evidence: Independent 3456-combination oracle: any uncertain/conflicting fact or unclear policy forces ASK; any original clarification is preserved; raw labels/decision unchanged.

160 decision/world/authorized-goal combinations retain historical physics/frames. Solo requires Shelter without actual companion; together requires companion; hold requires WAIT. Wrong-together/absent-Mara may still satisfy secondary solo completion, but primary trace agreement remains separate.

Duplicate objects at nested depths, nonfinite constants/exponent overflow, nonmaximum selection and excessive distribution sums rejected; tied maxima accepted. Ten independent negative probes plus checked-in decoder tests.

CI refuses even with both authorization flags, before docs network. Synthetic HTTP 429, timeout exception and response overflow each consume one admission, stop and reject refill. Success uses exactly planned calls. Ledger and request exist before transport; fsync exercised; exclusive run marker persists.

Actual verify_source returns exact reviewed commit. All 19 manifest-bound sources match both SHA256 and Git blobs, and inherited commit paths remain unchanged. All 24 in-memory request previews omit evaluator metadata, worlds and rationales.

Transparent grammar is intentionally not a general semantic oracle; 18 frozen development rows pass. No fresh heldout parser prediction was generated in this review. Collector iterates planned cases including absent/malformed responses; raw and gated metrics remain distinct. No post-holdout tuning approved.
